council_review.requirements: Campaign 11 is the defensible submission choice because it is current, cumulative, zero-failure, fully revalidated, and bound to the selected fingerprint. Historical and specialist rankings are separately labeled rather than conflated.
council_review.architecture: The consolidated docs preserve the cumulative design lineage: Campaign 5 owns hybrid attention and long-causal routing, Campaign 6 exact-width packed QKV, Campaigns 7, 8, 10, and 11 exact residual-normalization fusions, and Campaign 4 the width-eight attention mechanism.
council_review.implementation: No implementation bytes changed during consolidation. The unexecuted Campaign 12 scaffold and disposable local artifacts were removed; the active Campaign 11 source remains selected.
council_review.security_privacy: No credential, dependency, network, authentication, authorization, permission, telemetry, or external-system surface changed. Cleanup targets were resolved and bounded before destructive worktree removal.
council_review.testing_qa: The ranking is backed by complete final pairs, dedicated long runs, held-out and source-derived matrices, same-window candidate controls, profiler mechanisms, immutable failures, artifact contracts, and the repository-wide suite.
council_review.user_docs: README, loop plan, result index, technical report, campaign run-through, optimization history, and Campaign 11 ledger now identify one flagship, explain the best specialist campaigns, disclose Campaign 12 as unrun, and state what cleanup preserved.
council_review.devils_advocate: Campaign 5 has a slightly higher historical aggregate and stronger historical held-out pair, while Campaign 11 adds benchmark-specific exact guards. Selecting Campaign 11 is still preferable for submission because cross-window aggregate differences are not causal and only Campaign 11 is the current cumulative fully validated fingerprint.

conditions: Keep Campaign 11 as the submission fingerprint unless a future campaign starts with fresh evidence and completes every gate.
